name: Okamoto
source:
Okamoto is a specialist in identifying keys of all kinds, either physical keys or digital ones. He's only visible through a small window in the WC. [Spoiler]He is friends with [url=/c80801]Shinkai Tsuki[/url], and has worked with him since he was with his last partner.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the [url=https://killthepastwiki.com/Okamoto]Wiki[/url]]
